name: 26b_dspark_bf16
description: 26B Gemma4-A4B MoE-target DSpark config, BF16 target (quantization disabled) — the smoke/verify config for the 26B dense DSpark draft. Target = google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-text-only (MoE, 30 layers, hidden 2816, 128 experts top-8); draft = DENSE DSpark (design A, 4 draft layers, target_layer_ids=[3,11,19,28]) at /tmp/models/dspark/26b_finetune. spec_method=dspark, native block size 7 (spec_tokens=7). gpu_memory_utilization 0.8 for the 262144-vocab draft headroom. Mirrors 12b_dspark_bf16 but on the MoE 26B target. Override target/draft via GEMMA4_MODEL_PATH / GEMMA4_SPECULATOR_MODEL. enforce_eager=true for first-run smoke (no CUDA-graph surprises); flip to false once the accept rate is confirmed.
